title: Zephyr: Range Testing implementation
close_reason: Zephyr C implementation of spec 18.7 Range Testing: coap_rangetest.c + header (POST/GET /diag/rangetest with exact SenML+CBOR packs, GET /diag/traceroute, provider config API, Observe support, strict CBOR decoders), Kconfig LICHEN_COAP_RANGETEST + CMake wiring, coap_server doc comment, and lichen/tests/coap_rangetest twister suite consuming test/vectors/rangetest.json via generated fixture (gen_vectors.py). Verified locally: west twister -p qemu_x86/atom with ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=lichen, Zephyr SDK 0.16.8 on 4.1.0 workspace — 1/1 configurations passed, 6/6 test cases passed (all 23 vectors byte-exact incl. all 4.00 rejects, decode oracle verdicts, state/interval/update semantics, codec edge contracts). Cross-checked against python/src/lichen/coap/resources/rangetest.py and rust/lichen-client/src/rangetest.rs semantics (unknown keys ignored, uint-only values). Commit d76c6da69d.
